text:
maria: FYI - alerting just showed a spike in 5xxs across /v1/generate since 02:13 UTC. Root cause points to tokenizer NPE on long inputs. I have a hotfix branch (hotfix/tokenizer-npe-2026) ready.

maria: Need to push a quick release to prod. This is customer affecting for a subset of long prompts. Requesting expedited approvals to bypass full canary and pin the runtime image.

release-bot: Release request created: hotfix/tokenizer-npe-2026 -> prod. image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-hotfix.sha=abcdef1234
change_window=60m
canary_policy=standard (requires 2 approvers to skip)

aj: +1 to urgent deploy if we can pin server image to avoid the recent allocator change. Confirming image sha `abcdef1234` contains the allocator revert.

maria: Correct, `abcdef1234` includes allocator revert + tokenization NPE guard. Test stage passed on small load. Need 2 quick approvals to skip canary.

dan: Oncall here. Can you post clear rollback criteria and the minimal telemetry to watch? I can approve after seeing that.

maria: Rollback criteria:
- error_rate(/v1/generate) > 2.5% sustained for 3m OR
- p99 latency > 2s increase vs baseline for 5m OR
- tail OOMs / worker restarts > 1 in 10m
Runbook snippet: `https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tokenizer-npe`
Telemetry to watch: errors.per_min, latency.p50/p95/p99, worker_restarts, mem.free.

sre-oncall: I'll wire dashboards and set short-term alerts for those metrics. Also will open a temporary tracing span `hotfix:tokenizer` to sample 100% for 10m.

kate: I reviewed the PR and runbook. Approving expedited deploy. :+1:

aj: Approving as well. I'm available during the window. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Approvals recorded (2): kate, aj. Canary bypass authorized by policy.

deploy-bot: Starting deploy -> prod. image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-hotfix (sha=abcdef1234)
Strategy: skip-canary (per approvals), rollout parallel by region (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-south-1) with health-checks.

maria: Deploy started. Monitoring live metrics. Change window ends in 60m. Notifying CSMs and SRE pager.

sre-oncall: First 2 minutes: error_rate down to baseline in us-east-1. eu-west-1 shows small spike p95 -> 350ms. Watching.

deploy-bot: Region us-east-1: rollout complete, health checks passed. eu-west-1: partial traffic shift 50% -> 100% pending green metrics. ap-south-1: staged at 20%.

sre-oncall: eu-west-1 p99 increased slightly but within acceptable bounds. No worker restarts. mem.free stable.

maria: Will let it run 10m at full, then finalize. If any of the rollback criteria fire, we revert to previous image `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-14-main` and notify customers.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete across all regions. Post-deploy checks: errors.per_min = 0.2% (baseline 0.5%), p99 latency = baseline +/- 5%, worker_restarts = 0.

dan: Thanks team — I'm marking this as approved for expedited patch. Leaving watch for 30m in case of delayed regressions.

maria: Closing thread. Release notes: "hotfix: fix tokenizer NPE on long prompts, revert allocator change". Patch pinned and recorded in release history. :white_check_mark:

release-bot: Release recorded: hotfix/tokenizer-npe-2026 -> prod; image=abcdef1234; changelog="tokenizer NPE guard; revert allocator change"; notes_link=https://redwood.internal/releases/2026/hotfix-tokenizer-npe

kate: Nice work everyone.

aj: Good job.

sre-oncall: Keeping monitoring for additional 30m then will demote alert sampling.
